users.usernameHint: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens; start with a letter or number.

workbench.name: Name
workbench.sshKeyRequired: Paste the new SSH public key

workbench.rotateKeyHint: Within ~1 minute sshd accepts only the new key; /home/dev is untouched and open sessions are not cut.

jobs.gangNote: Gang scheduling: all replicas start or none; preemption requeues the whole job.

volumes.pendingHelp: Storage is allocated on first mount. Unmounted volumes remain Pending.

quota.nativeRowsNote: requests.cpu / limits.cpu / requests.memory here are the fixed per-pod overhead (500m / 1 CPU / 512Mi) added up — they bound the POD COUNT; compute entitlement is the GPU and sim rows.

fleetOps.desiredOnly: This writes DESIRED state only (NodeOwnership); drain / contract gate / sanitize gate run in the controller.
fleetOps.specSource: Spec source: NVIDIA DGX B300 User Guide; current utilization comes from the cluster.

monitoring.customHelp: Choose times in your browser’s timezone. Query up to 90 days at once.
monitoring.fixedWindow: Fixed historical window; time does not advance
monitoring.partialHistory: Only part of this window has historical data. Missing intervals are left blank on the full time axis.
monitoring.retentionNote: Available history depends on monitoring retention and collection. A longer range cannot restore expired or uncollected data.
monitoring.emptyHelp: Check metrics collection and service health, or select another time range.

rangeError.invalid: Enter valid start and end times.
rangeError.order: The end must be after the start.
rangeError.future: The end cannot be in the future.
